d: Sun-joo prepares her wedding. But her fiancée Ji-hoon plans to go on a business trip with a beautiful writer So-ra.
The victim's husband and suspected murderer's wife come together to track a real killer and solve the case, but both of them are hiding secrets from one another.
Three siblings must figure out what to do with a younger brother whom they were suddenly introduced to and did not know even existed before.
So-hee marries a perfect man. One day she suspects that he isn't as he seems and hires a private detective.
